protocol.splits: Chronological: train 1997-2012 (fit), validation 2013-2019 (every choice), test 2020-2026 (scored once after the freeze).
protocol.already_seen: team-season wins and net rating, 2013-2026; game and series outcomes, 2013-2015. The sim-1.0.0 test (2013-2015) results were inspected, so those seasons are development data here.

availability.regular_season_estimates: Retrospective. Inputs are completed-season stats of the same season (a model of what these players did, not a preseason forecast).
availability.playoff_predictions: Inputs are regular-season stats, all available before the postseason starts. No playoff games, results or awards enter any input.
availability.normalization: Each season's z-scores use only that season's regular-season qualified pool, so playoff predictions use nothing after the regular season.
availability.game_model: Game-model slope and home advantage are fitted on earlier seasons only. Team net rating is used as a regressor only in that fit and in the 'actual net rating' oracle baseline, which is labelled as not a prediction.

game_model_choice.rule: use playoff-specific parameters if validation playoff log loss improves by more than 0.002

frozen.already_seen_before_this_freeze: team-season wins and net rating, 2013-2026; game and series outcomes, 2013-2015
